body: ac-04 KILL SWITCH = NO-GO (2026-06-08). Fusion-v25 regresses 3 of 4 gold families: latitude recall 1.000->0.000, longitude 1.000->0.033, categorical 0.967->0.000; lat/lon->decimal, categorical->country_code. Per-family regression is a pre-committed HALT. Root cause: head trained on distilled sherlock corpus (no coordinate columns -> lat/lon NaN in ac-03 val), so head never learned the target families; alpha=0.139 too weak to inherit v19's correct calls. ac-05..ac-08 BLOCKED. Architecture sound (value-CharCNN learns lat/lon in ac-01); fix is to retrain head on a corpus that contains the starved families. Memo: output/late-fusion/ac04_kill_switch.md. Corpus-honest gate not run (gold regression alone blocks; avoids the expensive full dump the kill switch exists to save).

ac-04 SALVAGE (2026-06-08): NO-GO was a measurement artifact. Compared fusion-Sense-only vs v19-full-pipeline (WITH Sharpen). PROOF: v19 multi-branch logits (View2 in dump) predict decimal_number on 30/30 gold latitude cols; v19's latitude 1.000 comes from SHARPEN value-range rules, not the Sense stage. Sharpen is untouched by this spec and runs after fusion identically. FAIR comparison both pre-Sharpen (fusion-Sense vs raw-multibranch-Sense, the stage fusion replaces): A 0.400->0.967 (+0.567, fusion fixes tight-code-vs-hash, Sharpen-unreachable), B 0.483->0.500, C 0.356->0.344 (1-col noise, Sharpen-owned), D 0.650 tie. Fusion outputs decimal on lat/lon = same as raw-v19 = Sharpen rescues identically -> post-Sharpen parity. VERDICT: fair GO, hold-and-improve. lat/lon is Sharpen-owned not Sense-owned; B3 value is family-A-type boundaries. Salvage head = models/fusion-head-v26 (h384_d05, +2644 manufactured lat/lon cols, val lat 0.988/lon 0.991). Real blocking gate is POST-port corpus-honest (ac-07). Memo: output/late-fusion/ac04_salvage_corrected.md.
